children: Vancouver, B.C. – November 4, 2026 – TheNewswire - Keon Capital Inc. (“Keon” or the “Company”) (TSXV: KEON.H) is pleased to announce, further to its news releases of June 12, July 29 and October 27, 2026, that it has satisfied the requirements of the TSX Venture Exchange (the “TSXV”) for reactivation from the NEX. Accordingly, effective November 9, 2026, the Company will transition from the NEX board to become a Tier 2 “Mining” issuer on the TSXV under the symbol “KEON”.

Keon previously entered into an option agreement (the “Option Agreement”) dated as of June 5, 2026 with AJMining Ventures Ltd. (the “Optionor”), pursuant to which Keon was granted the option to earn a 100% interest in and to five mineral licenses prospective for uranium in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada, covering approximately 2,771 hectares (the “Crusader Property”) by: (1) paying $12,500 to the Optionor; and (2) issuing an aggregate of 7,000,000 Keon common shares (each, a “Share”) to or as directed by the Optionor. Keon has now successfully exercised its option under the Option Agreement and has acquired a 100% interest in and to the Crusader Property. In connection with its acquisition of the Crusader Property, Keon has filed a technical report dated August 11, 2026 (the “Technical Report”) titled “Technical Report for the Crusader Property, Southwest Athabasca Basin, Northern Saskatchewan, Canada”. The Technical Report was prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects and is available under the Company’s SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca.

Each Share issued under the Option Agreement is subject to: a four month hold period expiring March 5, 2027 in accordance with applicable securities laws and TSXV policies; and a contractual six month hold period expiring May 5, 2027, which will run concurrently. The Company did not pay any finder’s fees in connection the Option Agreement or its acquisition of the Crusader Property.

In connection with the acquisition of the Crusader Property, Keon closed a non-brokered private placement (the “Financing”) for gross proceeds of $750,000 through the issuance of 10,000,000 units (each, a “Unit”) at a price of $0.075 per Unit. Each Unit comprises one Share and one Share purchase warrant (each, a “Warrant”, exercisable for an additional Share at an exercise price of $0.10 for two years from the date of issuance). The Company paid aggregate finder’s fees of $8,331 in connection with the Financing. Securities issued under the Financing are subject to a four month hold period expiring March 5, 2027 in accordance with applicable Canadian securities laws. The Company intends to use the proceeds of the Financing to conduct exploration on the Crusader Property and for general working capital.

This news release is not an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy the securities in the United States or in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to qualification or registration under the securities laws of such jurisdiction. The securities being offered have not been, nor will they be, registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and such securities may not be offered or sold within the United States or to, or for the account or benefit of, U.S. persons absent registration or an applicable exemption from U.S. registration requirements and applicable U.S. state securities laws.
